title: Heart failure may promote breast cancer progression through a Col10a1-associated Tgf-beta/Smad-EMT pathway.
authors: Zhang, Danfeng; Wang, Man; Wu, LiHua; Gao, Bo; Ai, Yongbiao; Wang, Ziyang; Xu, Ming; Yang, Fengmei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究心衰促进乳腺癌进展的Col10a1/Tgf-beta/EMT通路，属纯湿实验与临床关联分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Heart failure (HF) is clinically associated with aggravated breast cancer (BC) progression; however, the integrative genomic mechanisms underlying this cardio-oncological crosstalk remain poorly understood. METHODS: We conducted integrative bioinformatics analyses combining weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) and machine learning algorithms to screen key hub genes involved in HF and BC progression. The candidate gene Col10a1 was further validated using myocardial infarction (MI)-induced HF xenograft mouse models, paired clinical plasma and tumor specimens, and comprehensive in vitro functional assays. RESULTS: COL10A1 expression was higher in breast cancer patients with CVD than in BC-only patients. Given the limited sample size, these findings were considered exploratory. Mechanistically, elevated Col10a1 was associated with activation of the transforming growth factor‑beta (Tgf-beta)/Smad signaling pathway and induction of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). In vivo, the HF microenvironment markedly accelerated BC tumor growth and was accompanied by enhanced Col10a1 expression and Tgf-beta signaling activation. In vitro, cardiomyocyte-derived Col10a1 significantly promoted the proliferation, migration, and invasion of BC cells, whereas Col10a1 knockdown significantly attenuated these malignant phenotypes. CONCLUSIONS: Our study identifies a potential regulatory link between HF and BC and provides preliminary mechanistic insights into the role of Col10a1 in BC progression under cardiac injury conditions. Col10a1 may serve as a candidate mediator in the interaction between cardiac injury and BC progression.
abstract_zh: 背景：心力衰竭（HF）在临床上与乳腺癌（BC）进展加剧相关；然而，这种心脏肿瘤学交叉对话背后的整合基因组机制仍知之甚少。方法：我们进行了整合生物信息学分析，结合加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和机器学习算法，筛选参与HF和BC进展的关键枢纽基因。候选基因Col10a1进一步通过心肌梗死（MI）诱导的HF异种移植小鼠模型、配对临床血浆和肿瘤标本以及全面的体外功能实验进行验证。结果：COL10A1在伴有心血管疾病（CVD）的乳腺癌患者中的表达高于仅患BC的患者。鉴于样本量有限，这些发现被视为探索性结果。机制上，Col10a1升高与转化生长因子-β（Tgf-beta）/Smad信号通路激活及上皮-间质转化（EMT）诱导相关。在体内，HF微环境显著加速了BC肿瘤生长，并伴随Col10a1表达增强和Tgf-beta信号激活。在体外，心肌细胞来源的Col10a1显著促进BC细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭，而Col10a1敲低则显著减弱这些恶性表型。结论：我们的研究确定了HF与BC之间潜在的调控联系，并为Col10a1在心脏损伤条件下BC进展中的作用提供了初步机制见解。Col10a1可能作为心脏损伤与BC进展相互作用中的候选介导因子。
